parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

By default, all accelerated domain names are queried.

parameters.name: DomainType
parameters.description: The type of the query. If you set this parameter to dynamic, the average response time of dynamic resources and the average response time of static resources for Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN) are queried. By default, this parameter is left empty, and the average response time of static resources is queried.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity of the query. Unit: seconds. The valid values vary based on the time range specified by **StartTime** and **EndTime**:

- If the time range is less than 3 days (3 days excluded), valid values are **300**, **3600**, and **86400**. Default value: **300**.

- If the time range is from 3 to 31 days (31 days excluded), valid values are **3600** and **86400**. Default value: **3600**.

- If the time range is 31 days or longer, the valid value is **86400**. Default value: **86400**.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description: The English name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to query ISP names. By default, all ISPs are queried.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description: The English name of the region. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to query region names. By default, all regions are queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: TimeMerge
parameters.description: Specifies whether to adaptively calculate the Interval value. If **timeMerge** is set to **1**, an appropriate interval value is calculated based on StartTime and EndTime. You can specify this parameter or the Interval parameter.
